law_validation.interpretation: Leave-one-experiment-condition-out forecast. A failed forecast is a failed candidate model, not a falsification of information theory.
law_validation.limitation: Scenario metadata and synthetic Bayes ceilings are given to the predictor; heldout real worlds require a new design.
